_readme: Owner: Set C. Text for the title, the ending card and the credits (card.title(), card.ending(), card.credits()). The NASA photo list is built in code from public/nasa/CREDITS.csv, using only the photos named in content/memories.json. Add each new sound or tool here when it goes in.

truth.en: The conversations are imagined. The machines, the places, the dates and the photos are real.
truth.ar: تخيّلنا هذه الحوارات. أمّا الآلات والأماكن والتواريخ والصور فحقيقية.
